podcast.title: Backing Richie Valens
podcast.body: As the new house band for Art Lebo's shows at El Monte Stadium, The Flips not only performed themselves but also backed other musicians, including Richie Valens, who played at these shows. "The Sleepwalkers joined Kip Tyler and guitarist Mike Dizzy in The Flips, and took over that role performing Gettel Monte, performing themselves, but also backing other musicians like Richie Valens, who played at these shows."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: House Band at El Monte Stadium
podcast.body: Kip Tyler and The Flips were considered a "hot band" in Los Angeles, particularly serving as the house band for Art Lebo's regular shows at El Monte Stadium. These shows were later immortalized by The Penguins in their song "Memories of El Monte." "In particular, they were the house band at Art LeBos' regular shows at El Monte Stadium, the shows which would later be immortalised by the penguins in Memories of El Monte."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Lineup Changes and The Sleepwalkers Join
podcast.body: The original piano player, Larry Knechtel, saxophone player, Steve Douglas, and drummer, Mike Bermani, left The Flips to join Dwayne Eddy's group. Kim Fowley, who was then a roadie for The Flips, connected the band with Bruce Johnston (piano), Dave Shostack (saxophone), and Sandy Nelson (drums) from The Sleepwalkers, who then joined Kip Tyler and guitarist Mike Dizzy to become the new lineup for The Flips. "But then the group's piano player Larry Nectal, saxophone player Steve Douglas, and drummer Mike Bermani, all left to join Dwayne at his group."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
